title: Time Bokan Series: Bokan to Ippatsu! Doronbow Kanpekiban
native_title: タイムボカンシリーズ ボカンと一発！ドロンボー 【完璧版】
overview:
This time the villains are the stars. Bokan to Ippatsu! Doronbow Kanpekiban is a vertical scrolling shooter based on the Time Bokan anime series, where you take control of the Doronbow gang - Doronjo, Boyacky and Tonzura - and fly their mechs against the heroes of the series.

Before each stage you pick a mech from the gang's lineup, but a mech you have used cannot be picked again for the next stage, and more machines join after the third stage. Each stage ends in a showdown with a hero from one of the Time Bokan shows, including Yatterman, Zendaman and Ippatsuman. In two-player mode, one player flies as Doronjo while the other takes Boyacky and Tonzura.

- Enemies, allies and supporting cast are all voiced
- Opening with an original theme song made for this game
- One or two players, memory backup saves
